summary: Apple's phone that put a full web browser and a multi-touch screen in a pocket. With the App Store a year later it turned phones into computers, ended plug-ins such as Flash on the mobile web, and became the most profitable product in history.

image.alt: The first iPhone on show at Macworld 2007

events.note: Steve Jobs announces "an iPod, a phone and an internet communicator" at Macworld.
The first iPhone goes on sale in the United States.

events.label: App Store
events.note: The App Store opens with the iPhone 3G.

events.label: 1 billion
events.note: Apple announces it has sold its billionth iPhone.

events.label: iPhone X
events.note: Drops the home button for Face ID.

events.label: USB-C
events.note: The iPhone 15 switches from Lightning to USB-C.
